one_liner: Squarespace has a broad REST Commerce API with OAuth 2.0 (manual client review) and per-site API keys (Commerce Advanced plan required); buildable with friction.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with 30-minute access tokens and refresh tokens; token endpoint uses HTTP Basic client auth. Client registration is reviewed manually by Squarespace. API keys are per-site bearer tokens and are not usable for the Webhook Subscriptions API (OAuth only).
access_notes: OAuth client_id/secret are issued only after Squarespace reviews the registration. The self-serve alternative, an API key, requires a paid Commerce Advanced plan for Orders, Inventory and Transactions. OAuth use also reportedly requires Squarespace Extensions.
blocker_notes: Multi-user OAuth needs manual Squarespace approval of the OAuth client. Testing with API keys needs a paid Commerce Advanced site.
